evidence_quotes.agenda: "aside from the price, what are you most worried about for this?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said "safety of the goods" — rep replied "For sure... let me tell you more about that" and pivoted directly into the pricing pitch with no actual follow-up question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you only pay for the actual time that you use" (pay-less concept); "take a car load... staging the boxes near the door... save time and money" (self-prep hit); "does that sound fair?" asked and got a genuine yes.

top_strength: Textbook-clean quid pro quo opener — time-boxed ask plus accurate-quote promise, delivered before any probing began.
coaching_note: The care/safety concern the customer explicitly raised got only a one-line acknowledgment before pivoting straight to price — a follow-up question there would build more trust before the number lands.
